Subject: Initial vendor banking packet & PO-invoice remittance template

Hi Susan,

Thanks for starting the vendor onboarding process with us — excited to get NimbleOps set up. Attached are our vendor onboarding form and the remittance template we use for PO-tagging (see attachment stubs below). To keep the payments flow simple, can you please: 

1) Complete the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf with your legal entity and banking information (ACH and wire).
2) Return a signed bank authorization letter (bank_letter_signed.pdf) or equivalent on bank letterhead.
3) Confirm whether your accounts support micro-deposit verification (preferred) or if you require a test ACH with a reference.
4) Upload a scanned W-9 (or local tax form) if available.

Remittance mapping notes (fill out remit_template.csv):
- Preferred remittance field for PO mapping: we recommend using "RemittanceDesc" with a format like "PO:{PO_NUMBER} INV:{INVOICE_NUMBER}".
- If you need separate invoice-only remits, indicate that in the "notes" column on the CSV.

What to expect: once we receive the filled form + bank letter, our FinOps team will trigger micro-deposits (two small ACHs) within 48 business hours. After you validate the micro-deposit amounts, we'll flip the account to live ACH for invoice payments. If your account prefers wires, note the wire acceptance window and any beneficiary requirements.

Attachments (stubs):
- vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)
- remit_template.csv (CSV sample showing PO mapping columns)

Next steps: if you can return the onboarding packet by end of day Monday (2027-05-17), we should be able to complete verification and accept first remittances the week of 5/24.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you'd rather walk through the form.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference

Hi Susan — thanks for the quick response and for sharing the bank letter. A few clarifications from FinOps below so we can avoid rework: 

- Intermediary bank details: include them in the wire section only if the receiving bank requires them. For regular ACH there's no intermediary field needed. If you include SWIFT/IBAN for wires, that will be sufficient.
- Micro-deposit workflow: we'll send two small ACHs (under $0.50) from "Redwood Inference" and ask you to confirm the amounts back to finance@nimbleops.com. Please copy me so I can toggle the account live.
- W-9: if you attach the completed W-9 (w9_redwood_signed.pdf) to your reply that's perfect — we'll add it to the vendor record.

PO tagging: to ensure automated reconciliation, please populate remit_template.csv with these columns: "PO_Number","Invoice_Number","Total","RemittanceDesc". For RemittanceDesc use the string: "PO:{PO_Number} INV:{Invoice_Number}". If NimbleOps sends multiple invoice lines per payment please indicate the primary invoice in "Invoice_Number" and add a short note in "Notes" column.

Attachments (stubs):
- expected: w9_redwood_signed.pdf (please attach when you send back)

Tentative timeline: once we receive the completed PDF + W-9 and validate micro-deposits, we will:
- Day 0: mark account validated and create vendor ID in ERP
- Day 1: accept first scheduled ACH payment cycle (next weekly run)

If all that looks good, go ahead and send the completed forms and W-9. I'll coordinate with Marissa (PO mapping) and Priya (vendor record creation) to turn this green.

Thanks,
Sean
